build_DVC_model: build a DVC deep video compression model with default coder channels and motion estimator
compress_DVC_frames: compress two consecutive video frames into a CompressedPFrame with motion and residual data
decompress_DVC_frames: decompress a CompressedPFrame with a base image to reconstruct the next video frame
train_DVC_forward: run the DVC forward pass on two images to get flow, residual, and probability estimates
update_DVC_entropy: update the DVC entropy bottleneck CDF values after training for actual entropy coding
